How can advance weather warnings help to reduce the impact of severe storms?
In this project, you will:

• Explore different weather-related hazards that everyone needs to be aware of, such as tsunamis, tornadoes, and hurricanes, and the warning systems that are in place to help protect people, animals and the environments.
• Create and program a device that could warn people to take evasive action in light of severe weather.
• Present and document your solution and explain how it helps to reduce the impact on the population.
